description: Curated contract grouping; no file, dependency, or ReUI example is admitted into the Pi catalog by this metadata.

implementationPolicy.declarative: Use reviewed JSON templates and generated-manifest.json when the pattern has no independent React state or custom handlers.
implementationPolicy.react: Use a reviewed React adapter with a strict semantic Zod API for coordinated state, behavior, or domain-specific meaning.
implementationPolicy.primitive: Extend the existing primitive schema for safe reusable variations, without creating duplicate Pi types.
implementationPolicy.reui: Keep examples gallery-only. A reviewed semantic decision is required for every example; React preview exposure never implies Pi admission.
